# ciphertrust_azure_secret (Resource)

Use this resource to add a secret to a CipherTrust Manager Azure vault. The mode is chosen by whether restore_secret is set.

- No block (default): creates a new secret in the vault from name and azure_params.
- restore_secret: restores a purged secret from its backup into the vault nominated by vault_id.

All inputs are immutable except `azure_params.content_type`, `azure_params.tags` and `azure_params.attributes`, which are updated in place.

To create a new version of a secret, create another secret resource with the same name.

If a soft-deleted secret of the same name exists in the vault, creating the resource recovers it instead of creating a new secret. This requires `recover_soft_deleted_secrets` to be true in the provider settings, otherwise the create fails.

On destroy, the secret is soft-deleted and, if `purge_secrets_on_delete` is true in the provider settings (the default), purged. If it is false, the secret is only soft-deleted.

The secret value is not read back after it is created. After an import `azure_params.value` is null and can be set in the configuration without forcing a change.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Pre-requisites for an Azure secret - Azure connection, Azure vault.
# This file shows the available options and need not be valid as a whole.

# Provider settings that affect Azure secrets. All are optional.
provider "ciphertrust" {
  cloud_key_manager = {
    azure = {
      # On destroy, purge a secret after it is soft-deleted, if purge is
      # supported by the vault. Default is true. If false, the secret is only
      # soft-deleted.
      purge_secrets_on_delete = true

      # If creating a secret fails because the name belongs to a soft-deleted
      # secret, recover that secret instead. Default is false.
      recover_soft_deleted_secrets = false
    }
  }
}

# Define an Azure connection
resource "ciphertrust_azure_connection" "connection" {
  name          = "azure-connection"
  client_id     = "your-client-id"
  tenant_id     = "your-tenant-id"
  client_secret = "your-client-secret"
  products      = ["cckm"]
}

# Get the subscriptions available to the connection
data "ciphertrust_azure_subscription_details" "subs" {
  connection_id = ciphertrust_azure_connection.connection.id
}

# Add an Azure vault to CipherTrust Manager
resource "ciphertrust_azure_vault" "vault" {
  name            = "my-key-vault"
  connection_id   = ciphertrust_azure_connection.connection.id
  subscription_id = data.ciphertrust_azure_subscription_details.subs.subscriptions[0].subscription_id
}

# Create a secret in the vault with the minimum options.
# name and azure_params.value are required. The value is not read back after
# the secret is created.
resource "ciphertrust_azure_secret" "minimal" {
  vault_id = ciphertrust_azure_vault.vault.id
  name     = "minimal-secret"
  azure_params = {
    value = "my-secret-value"
  }
}

# Create a secret in the vault with all the available options.
# Only content_type, tags and attributes can be updated after the secret is
# created. Everything else is immutable.
resource "ciphertrust_azure_secret" "secret" {
  vault_id = ciphertrust_azure_vault.vault.id
  name     = "my-secret"
  azure_params = {
    value        = "my-secret-value"
    content_type = "password"
    # Optional. Set tags = {} to remove all tags.
    tags = {
      environment = "test"
    }
    # Optional
    attributes = {
      enabled = true
      # RFC3339 format, UTC. expiration_date must be later than activation_date.
      # A date cannot be cleared once it is set.
      activation_date = "2026-07-03T14:24:00Z"
      expiration_date = "2030-07-03T14:24:00Z"
    }
  }
}

# Restore a purged secret into a vault from its CipherTrust Manager backup.
# secret_id is the CipherTrust Manager ID of the purged secret. It is no longer
# in Terraform state, so it is not a reference to another resource. vault_id can
# be any vault. name and azure_params cannot be set.
resource "ciphertrust_azure_secret" "restored" {
  vault_id = ciphertrust_azure_vault.vault.id
  restore_secret = {
    secret_id = "purged-secret-id"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `vault_id` (String) (Conditionally immutable) CipherTrust Manager resource ID of the Azure vault that contains the secret. Can only be changed if the previously configured vault no longer exists in CipherTrust Manager. When restore_secret is set this is the vault the secret is restored to; it can be any vault. A vault name is not accepted.

### Optional

- `azure_params` (Attributes) Azure secret parameters. `value` is required unless `restore_secret` is set. Cannot be set when `restore_secret` is set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--azure_params))
- `name` (String) (Immutable) Name of the secret. May contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens. Required unless restore_secret is set, in which case it cannot be set.
- `restore_secret` (Attributes) (Immutable) Restores a purged secret into `vault_id` instead of creating a new one. Cannot be combined with `name` or `azure_params`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--restore_secret))

### Read-Only

- `account` (String) CipherTrust Manager account that owns the secret.
- `azure_created_at` (String) Time the secret was created in Azure.
- `azure_updated_at` (String) Time the secret was last updated in Azure.
- `backup` (String) CipherTrust Manager resource ID of the Azure secret backup.
- `backup_at` (String) Time the secret was last backed up.
- `cloud_name` (String) Azure cloud of the vault.
- `created_at` (String) Time the secret was created in CipherTrust Manager.
- `created_by` (String) Identity that created the secret.
- `deleted` (Boolean) Whether the secret is deleted.
- `gone` (Boolean) Whether the secret no longer exists in Azure.
- `id` (String) CipherTrust Manager resource ID of the secret.
- `modified_by` (String) Identity that last modified the secret.
- `region` (String) Azure region of the vault.
- `secret_soft_deleted_in_azure` (Boolean) Whether the secret is soft-deleted in Azure.
- `soft_delete_enabled` (Boolean) Whether soft delete is enabled on the vault.
- `status` (String) Status of the secret.
- `synced_at` (String) Time the secret was last synchronized with Azure.
- `tenant` (String) Azure tenant of the vault.
- `updated_at` (String) Time the secret was last updated in CipherTrust Manager.
- `uri` (String) CipherTrust Manager URI of the secret.
- `vault_name` (String) Name of the Azure vault that contains the secret.
- `version` (String) Azure version of the secret.
- `version_count` (Number) Number of versions of the secret.

<a id="nestedatt--azure_params"></a>
### Nested Schema for `azure_params`

Optional:

- `attributes` (Attributes) Attributes of the secret. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--azure_params--attributes))
- `content_type` (String) Type of the secret value, for example password.
- `tags` (Map of String) Application specific metadata in the form of key-value pairs. Removing the attribute from the configuration does not clear the tags, set it to an empty map (`tags = {}`) to remove all tags.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) (Immutable) Value of the secret.

Read-Only:

- `recoverable_days` (Number) Number of days a soft-deleted secret can be recovered.
- `recovery_level` (String) Azure recovery level of the secret.
- `secret_id` (String) Azure identifier of the secret.

<a id="nestedatt--azure_params--attributes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `azure_params.attributes`

Optional:

- `activation_date` (String) Date of secret activation in UTC time in RFC3339 format. For example, 2026-07-03T14:24:00Z. Before this time the secret cannot be used. A date cannot be cleared once it is set.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the secret is enabled.
- `expiration_date` (String) Date of secret expiry in UTC time in RFC3339 format. For example, 2030-07-03T14:24:00Z. Must be later than activation_date. A date cannot be cleared once it is set.



<a id="nestedatt--restore_secret"></a>
### Nested Schema for `restore_secret`

Required:

- `secret_id` (String) CipherTrust Manager resource ID of the purged secret to restore. It is no longer in Terraform state.
